_comment: Editorial content for PASM. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: no licence-cleared photograph of the company's own facilities exists, and a generic industry photograph would imply it is theirs. Add imagePath/imageSource/imageLicence together when a real one is available. The company's own site is small and several fields it does not publish are left null rather than filled from directories.
description: Paramount Spinning Mills Limited describes its business as the progressive manufacture and sale of cotton yarn, fabric, yarn dyeing and garments, with mills at S.I.T.E. Kotri and on 18-Km Raiwind Road, Lahore, and its registered office at Finlay House on I.I. Chundrigar Road, Karachi. Its stated vision is to rebuild the company and its mission to become again a quality manufacturer of textile products. It is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange under the symbol PASM.
headOffice: 2nd Floor, Finlay House, I.I. Chundrigar Road, Karachi, Pakistan
